newsitem.title: INDIA: India approves aid package for ailing shipbuilders.
newsitem.headline: India approves aid package for ailing shipbuilders.

text.p: India on Monday announced an aid package for the ailing shipbuilding industry including a five-year, 30-percent subsidy to bring down prices to world levels, the Surface Transport Ministry said.
"The government has approved introduction of shipbuilding subsidy scheme for a period of five years to public sector shipyards for both domestic and export orders," the ministry said.
"Under the scheme the government would be paying 30 percent subsidy to the yard over and above the international price of the vessel," it said.
The ministry said it was encouraged by a capital restructuring plan at the once-ailing Cochin Shipyards Ltd, and had approved a similar package for Hindustan Shipyard Ltd.
It announced that the government was writing off 4.7 billion rupees ($130 million) of government loans and interest, and converting 1.2 billion rupees of debt into equity as part of the package.
